title: Heritage 911 — Classic Cars Catalog
status: screen-reference reconstruction using matched archived media; not the original licensed photographs

assumptions.measurement_status: screen-pixel estimates from a 1536x1024 raster screenshot, not exact source Figma dimensions

typography.serif: editorial contrast serif similar to Didone/Bodoni

font_and_ui_text: all labels, prices, prices and specs are HTML/CSS text, not raster assets

process.note: All photographic scene backgrounds and their own contact shadows are inside the photo; screen and button shadows live in CSS. The source screenshot and model reconstructed detail board are visual references, not original photographs.

assumptions.screenshot_measurements: All coordinates are estimates read from a 1536×1024 flattened screenshot; not verified Figma/design data.

assets.generation_prompt: Ivory 1964 Porsche 911 from rear-left three-quarter angle, cropped at right, in a warm pale-grey minimalist studio. Car enters from lower right occupying about 83% frame width and 51% frame height. No editorial typography, UI, buttons, watermarks.

reuse_disclosure: Image/photo assets and 16 core SVG paths are byte-identical reuse of screenshot-matching media already published in this same repository under images/porsche-911-heritage-archive. Three white stroke-state icons were added for this project. Not independently re-generated photographs.

rendering_notes.raster_output: WebP photographic layers, RGB (no alpha), source background and contact shadow included
rendering_notes.raster_scale: Three times the estimated display rectangle for every photograph. Resampling cannot recover missing source detail.
rendering_notes.object_fit: Use object-fit and object-position per asset; do not stretch along only one axis.
rendering_notes.icon_output: SVG transparent background; button circles, badges and nav panels are separate UI layers.
rendering_notes.text_output: All headings, prices, years, pagination and buttons are live interface text and must not be burned into the photographs.
rendering_notes.crop_occlusion: The rear car is cut by viewport boundary; the lower home cards continue below the fixed navigation overlay, without extrapolating hidden parts.

hero_wall.notes: The vertical architectural shadow gradient is part of the center hero photo; do not add a separate duplicate CSS shadow.
